Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine

Class FloorContents

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.engine.FloorContents
public class FloorContents extends Object
Everything on one floor besides its terrain: monsters, friendly NPCs, traps and piles of items. The session keeps one of these per visited depth, so a floor's contents are preserved when the player leaves it.
